messages:
mara: Heads-up — onboarding sample app is failing for a customer. SDK create-route returns 422 but the same REST call works. Suspecting param/shape drift (timeout vs timeout_ms?) and model_variant missing in SDK. Anyone seen this?

aj: Can you paste the request examples + error? quick guess: param name drift between SDK and REST or SDK is normalizing/omitting unknown fields.

mara: Repro snippets below. REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"name":"test","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":30}'
```
SDK (422):
```js
// js SDK - using latest pinned package
client.routes.create({ name: 'test', model: 'gpt-open-3', timeout_ms: 30000 })
// no model_variant field available in autocomplete
```

aj: Ah — docs show REST accepts timeout (seconds) and model_variant; JS SDK current shape has timeout_ms and no model_variant. Also noticed SDK serializes unknowns away. That mismatch would explain 422 for required variant in backend validation.

sam: Another gotcha: SDK has auto-retry enabled for 4xx/5xx by default in our client wrapper. For POST create-route that's non-idempotent — retries can cause duplicate resources or double billing. Customer saw two route creations.

mara: Logs showing duplicate events:
```
[2024-10-11T14:00:01Z] POST /v1/routes idempotency: - header missing - request id: r_abc123
[2024-10-11T14:00:02Z] POST /v1/routes request id: r_def456 (same payload)
```
No Idempotency-Key sent by SDK, and retry layer retried once after a 500 from infra.

leo: Workaround for now: pass an explicit Idempotency-Key and disable autoRetry in client config. e.g.
```js
client = new RedwoodClient({ autoRetry: false, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uid() } })
```
That prevents duplication until we patch.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4823: "js-sdk: expose model_variant + align timeout param; disable auto-retry for non-idempotent by default" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-4823 :robot_face:

aj: Thanks. Can you add a minimal repro (sample app and exact sdk version) to the ticket? I'll take the SDK fix: expose model_variant, accept both timeout and timeout_ms (convert), and tighten retry policy for POST.

mara: Adding sample app link + curl vs sdk diff to DEVEX-4823. cc @sam for retry policy review. Will add a short test that compares REST <-> SDK payload shapes.

sam: I'll review retry defaults and propose a change: autoRetry true only for idempotent methods (GET/PUT with idempotency-key opt-in for POST).

mara: Sweet — thanks all. Leaving the thread here, will update ticket when I push the repro. :thumbsup:
